preset.text:
Avoid taking penalty cards!
Hearts = 1 point each. Queen of Spades = 13 points.
The player with the lowest score wins.
Game ends when someone hits 100 points.

The 2 of Clubs leads the first trick.
You must follow suit if you can.
Trick winner = highest card of the lead suit (no trumps).
Hearts cannot be led until a heart has been played on a previous trick.

Before each deal, pass 3 cards to a neighbor (direction rotates).
Shoot the Moon: If you take ALL hearts + Queen of Spades, everyone else gets 26 points and you get 0!
